subject: microbiology
title: CD Markers, Lymphoid Organs and the Thymus

steps.tx: **CD markers** (cluster of differentiation) are numbered surface molecules that barcode immune cells for counting and sorting: CD3 all T cells, CD4 helpers, CD8 cytotoxic, CD19 and CD20 B cells, CD16 and CD56 NK cells, CD34 stem cells, read by flow cytometry antibodies in immunodeficiency and leukaemia work. The number is an address examiners expect paired with its cell.
steps.say: CD numbers are cell addresses; pair each number with its cell or lose the mark.

left.title: Lineage badges
points: CD3 T, CD4 helper, CD8 cytotoxic
CD19, CD20 B cells (CD20 is rituximab target)

steps.tx: **CD markers** are numbered surface molecules, the cluster of differentiation system, used to barcode immune cells. CD3 marks every T cell, CD4 helpers, and CD8 cytotoxic T cells. CD19 and CD20 mark B cells. CD16 together with CD56 marks natural killer cells. CD34 marks stem cells. Fluorescent antibodies and flow cytometry read these addresses in immunodeficiency and leukaemia. Each number is useless unless it is paired with its cell, which is exactly what the gated plot is for.
steps.say: CD numbers are surface addresses read by flow cytometry. CD3 marks T cells, CD4 helpers, and CD8 cytotoxic cells. CD19 and CD20 mark B cells. CD16 and CD56 mark natural killer cells. CD34 marks stem cells. Immunodeficiency and leukaemia panels depend on pairing each number with its cell.

vis.alt: Flow cytometry scatter plots show gated lymphocyte populations labelled by CD3, CD4, CD8, CD19, and CD56.
vis.caption: Antibody stains separate T cells, helper and cytotoxic subsets, B cells, and natural killer cells as distinct clouds on the plot. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Primary lymphoid organs** (bone marrow and thymus) manufacture and educate lymphocytes without antigen, while **secondary lymphoid organs** (nodes, spleen, MALT) stage antigen meetings. Cells failing education die on site; cells graduating naive patrol blood and lymph, homing to nodes via high endothelial venules awaiting their antigen.
steps.say: Primary organs educate, secondary organs introduce antigen; geography is immunology.

left.title: Primary organs
points: Bone marrow: all blood cells, B maturation

right.title: Secondary organs
points: Spleen: blood borne antigen, red cell duties

steps.tx: The **thymus** selects T cells by self MHC and self peptide auditions: cortex positive selection keeps MHC readers, medulla negative selection (AIRE displaying tissue antigens) deletes strong self reactors, producing single positive CD4 or CD8 cells. It involutes after puberty, and its congenital absence (DiGeorge) presents in the immunodeficiency module as absent T cells with parathyroid and cardiac neighbours.
steps.say: Keep MHC readers, delete self attackers: thymic selection in one audition.

nodes.label: Medullary negative selection deletes self reactive

steps.tx: **Lymph node architecture** organises the meeting: cortex B follicles with germinal centres, paracortex T zones with dendritic cells, medullary cords plasma cells, afferent lymph in and efferent out, high endothelial venules admitting naive lymphocytes from blood. Palpable nodes are this architecture inflamed, and biopsy reads its compartments.
steps.say: Cortex B, paracortex T, medulla plasma: node anatomy is cell geography.

left.title: Node compartments
points: Cortex: B follicles and germinal centres
Paracortex: T cells and dendritic presentation
Medulla: cords of plasma cells, sinuses of macrophages
HEV: naive lymphocyte entry from blood

right.title: Clinical echoes
points: Paracortical expansion: viral and T responses
Metastatic and lymphoma staging reads nodes

steps.tx: The **spleen** filters blood without afferent lymphatics: white pulp (periarteriolar T sheaths and B follicles with marginal zones) samples blood borne antigen, red pulp culls old red cells and plates, and its loss (surgery, sickle autoinfarction) invites overwhelming sepsis by encapsulated bacteria, the capsule lesson's organisms returning with vaccination prescriptions.
steps.say: No spleen, no marginal zone filter; encapsulated bacteria send the invoice.

left.title: White pulp duties
points: Marginal zone B cells: polysaccharide responses

right.title: Asplenia consequences
points: Howell Jolly bodies mark absent filtering

steps.tx: **Flow cytometry** counts CD badges by laser scatter and fluorescence on single cells in fluid, immunophenotyping leukaemias, measuring CD4 counts in HIV, and diagnosing immunodeficiency subsets, with gating strategies (CD45 versus side scatter) as its grammar. It is the CD system's measuring instrument and examination partner.
steps.say: Flow cytometry interrogates thousands of cells a second by their CD badges.

left.title: Flow outputs
points: B, T and NK enumeration in immunodeficiency

right.title: Flow grammar
points: Forward scatter size, side scatter granularity

steps.tx: **MALT** (mucosa associated lymphoid tissue) stations lymphocytes at entry surfaces: Peyer patches sampling gut antigen via M cells, tonsils at the throat, appendix and bronchial tissue, secreting IgA onto surfaces. Its lymphomas (MALT lymphoma of stomach with Helicobacter) and its vaccine route logic (oral and nasal) extend the geography clinically.
steps.say: MALT guards the doors microbes actually use; its antibody is IgA.

left.title: MALT stations
points: Lacteal and lamina propria plasma cells

steps.tx: **Stem cell markers and transplantation** close the geography: CD34 selection enriches grafts, HLA matching (immune response module) outranks CD logic, and thymic output assays (TRECs in newborn screening for SCID) measure education in real time. A newborn's absent TRECs are DiGeorge and SCID knocking before infections announce them.
steps.say: TRECs count fresh thymic graduates; absent TRECs in a newborn are an emergency referral.

right.title: Screening markers
points: B cell counts guide re vaccination after depletion
Absolute lymphocyte counts as bedside proxy
